official_title: National Housing Development Authority Act Amendment
raw_text:
1. This Act may be cited as the National Housing Short title.
Development Authority (Amendment) Act, No. 23 of 2002.

2. Section 63 of the National Housing Development Amendment of
Authority Act, No. 17 of 1979 (hereinafter referred to as section 63 of
Act No. 17 of
the “principal enactment”) is hereby amended in subsection
1979.
(1) of that section by the substitution for the words “lawful
termination of the occupation of such building by the
occupier” ; of the words “lawful termination of the
occupation of such building by the landlord” .

3. Section 82 of the principal enactment is hereby Amendment of
amended by the substitution, for the words “any property, section 82 of
the principal
business and any activity of the Authority”, of the words
enactment.
“any property, business and any activity of the Authority or
to any legal proceeding relating to such property, business
or activity.” .

4. The Schedule to the principal enactment is hereby Amendment to
amended by the addition immediately after the item “Rent the Schedule to
the principal
Act, No. 7 of 1972,” of the following item “Mediation Board
enactment.
Act, No. 72 of 1988,”.

5. In the event of any inconsistency between the Sinhala Sinhala text to
and Tamil texts of this Act, the Sinhala text shall prevail. prevail in case
of
inconsistency.
2—H 016471—5,650 (2002/08)
2 National Housing Development Authority
(Amendment) Act, No. 23 of 2002
Annual subscription of English Bills and Acts of the Parliament Rs. 885 (Local), Rs. 1,180(Foreign),
payable to the SUPERINTENDENT, GOVERNMENT PUBLICATIONS BUREAU, NO. 32, TRANSWORKS HOUSE,
LOTUS ROAD, COLOMBO 01 before 15th December each year in respect of the year following.
